public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] arr = new int[1005];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        
        if (n >= 1) {
            // Sort the array to find the median
            Arrays.sort(arr, 0, n);
            if (n >= 2) {
                System.out.println(arr[n / 2]);
            } else {
                System.out.println(arr[0]);
            }
        }
    }
}
